description: Retrieves up to k relevant snippets from .ai/knowledge/, .ai/instruct.md hierarchy, and the five naming registries for a query. Implementation is pluggable: lexical (grep + ranking) by default; can be upgraded to embedding-based (e.g., sqlite-vss, chromadb) without changing the contract. Prefer this over ad-hoc grep when an agent needs cross-cutting context.
checklist: 1. Validate inputs: query (non-empty string), k (int 1..20, default 5), scopes (optional list; default ['knowledge','instruct','registries'])
2. Run pause-check before any filesystem read
3. Resolve scope roots: knowledge=.ai/knowledge/, instruct=walk for .ai/instruct.md, registries=.ai/{coding-prefixes,api-conventions,database-schema,error-codes,config-vars}.md
4. Search via the configured backend (lexical by default). Each match returns { path, line_range, snippet, score, scope }
5. Rank by score; cap results at k; never return secrets, .env, or paths under .archive/
6. Surface to caller as a list; the caller decides whether to read the full file
7. Log via log-action with action='retrieve-knowledge', files_affected=[matched paths], outcome='success'
